events.title: Pisgah Rage Pre-season
events.description: Pre-season activities including social events, rider assessment, bike shop night, parent meeting, and 1-2 adventure rides. Starts around mid-October.

events.title: Pisgah Rage Regular Season
events.description: Regular season with practices and races. Indoor training January. February: 1 weekend practice per week. March-May: 2 rides per week (weeknight and weekend). Races typically 5-6 across North Carolina beginning early March.
